name: OPA210 / OPA2210 / OPA4210
type: Super-beta bipolar precision op-amp, 36 V, 1/2 channels
tagline: TI's 2018 successor to the OPAx209: 2.2 nV/√Hz, low 1/f noise and µV-level offset on 36 V supplies.

lineage.note: OPAx209 family; TI calls the OPAx210 its next generation.
OPA2210 launched Sep 2018 (rev *); OPA210 single in production by rev H (Aug 2021).

part_numbers.note: SOIC-8 (D), VSSOP-8 (DGK), SON (DRG, production since rev E). No DIP-8.
Preview at rev F; D in production at G, DBV and DGK at H.
Unconfirmed: no TI page found; SBOS924 names only OPA210 and OPA2210.

key_specs.value: 5 µV typ / 35 µV max; drift 0.6 µV/°C max

reputation.summary: Liked in phono and DIY circles. Hagerman sells an OPA2210 upgrade for the Bugle MC phono preamp promising about 6 dB less noise, and a TNT-Audio reviewer was surprised by the change. Audiophonics buyers report more clarity and better bass. Head-Fi reports are mixed. The datasheet confirms rail-to-rail output.
typical_uses: MC phono preamp gain stage (Hagerman Bugle MC)
I/V stage after a current-output DAC
caveats: DIP8 versions are SOIC-on-adapter builds; TI makes no DIP package.
Head-Fi: one user got hum after a swap; another heard no difference from LM833 or OPA2107.
Praise rests on a small number of sources.

counterfeit_notes: No counterfeit reports. TI makes no DIP-8 (only SOIC-8, VSSOP-8, SON and SOT-23-5 for OPA210), so any 'OPA2210 DIP8' is an SOIC on an adapter. Check the SOIC marking.
